description:
Advances: specled.coverage_capture

Found by the specled_-dn4.9 audit (2026-07-26T00:25:30Z). specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta's statement covers the tolerant READ of a missing :meta, but never states the present-but-non-map rejection rule that store_test.exs now asserts after dn4.9 item 14. The test is ahead of the requirement.

Fix: state the rejection rule in the requirement so the assertion has an owning clause. Purely additive, so append-only-safe.

comments.text:
Resolved by branch specled_-td7/self-identifying-descriptors, commit 3bbd7e7b, while implementing specled_-n5s (session a5f50a6d-689f-4616-80ad-806b0595aa28).

n5s's fix needed an owning clause for write_v2/2's exception contract in specled.coverage_capture, and its new test asserts the present-but-non-map :meta rejection — leaving that rule unstated would have widened this ticket rather than left it alone. specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta now states: write_v2/2 tolerates a missing :meta on the same terms as read_v2/1, and rejects a present-but-non-map :meta as malformed. Covered by scenario specled.coverage_capture.scenario.envelope_meta_tolerant_read.

Not closing it here — that call belongs to whoever grades the PR. Verify against the branch and close if satisfied.

title: envelope_meta requirement under-specifies its own test: present-but-non-map :meta rejection is asserted but unstated
